hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom curve AMM hook that fully replaces Uniswap v4's CLAMM with its own bonding curve (CurveLib). In beforeSwap, it computes quotes, deposits input tokens into Euler lending vaults (via EVC), withdraws output tokens from vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to settle the swap entirely outside the pool's tick-based engine. Reverts on beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate to prevent unproductive positions.
